title: Fine-Tuning & Alignment
blurb: LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, reward modeling, RLHF, DPO, efficient fine-tuning with Unsloth.

lecture.summary: Master the full spectrum of model adaptation and alignment — LoRA/PEFT, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward modelling, PPO-based RLHF, DPO, constitutional-AI concepts, prompt tuning, and continual learning — applied to the Transformer language models built in Modules 08 and 10.
takeaways: The RLHF stack: reward modeling, PPO, and DPO — plus constitutional-AI concepts.
Catastrophic forgetting, continual learning, and alignment evaluation & safety.

snippet.caption: LoRA: freeze W, learn a tiny low-rank update.
snippet.code:
# A: d->r, B: r->d, with r << d  (a few % of the params)
delta = (x @ A) @ B
y = x @ W_frozen + alpha * delta
